messages.content:
Risk: Sensitive Information Disclosure (ID: llm022025-sensitive-information-disclosure)
Description: Sensitive information can affect both the LLM and its application context. This includes personal identifiable information (PII), financial details, health records, confidential business data, security credentials, and legal documents. Proprietary models may also have unique training methods and source code considered sensitive, especially in closed or foundation models.
Concern: None
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Axis: Financial Data Exposure (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TransactionHistoryExposure: Transaction History Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AccountNumberExposure: Account Number Exposure
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#CreditScoreExposure: Credit Score Exposure

Axis: context (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context)
Roles: location
Subclasses:

  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/SitesAndFacilities/Site: site
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/GreenLoans/AssessmentBoundary: assessment boundary
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialIndustryContext: financial industry context
